title: Long-Term Care &
Rehabilitation
hero.text: Continuous care and rehabilitation for patients with chronic and complex needs, including long-term, geriatric and paediatric care.

overview: Long term care supports patients who require ongoing medical management, 24/7 nursing care and sustained rehabilitation over an extended period. At Cambridge Hospital, care is centred on stability, dignity and meaningful human connection, supporting patients who may require ongoing medical support, ventilator management or continuous nursing care over months or years.

Each care plan is tailored to the individual, with structured routines and consistent support designed around their needs. Through continuity of care, active family involvement and a personalised approach, we work to preserve dignity, maintain function and enhance quality of life, regardless of the complexity of each patient’s medical needs.
